title: Health Information Trust Alliance Common Security Framework Controls

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Management
controls.mandate: Cryptographic keys shall be managed through a centralized key management system supporting key generation, distribution, and automated annual rotation.

controls.title: Data Protection at Rest
controls.mandate: Sensitive data at rest including electronic protected health information must be encrypted using industry-standard algorithms (AES-256 or RSA-2048+).

controls.title: Audit Logging and Telemetry
controls.mandate: Audit trails recording exceptions, security-relevant events, and administrative activities shall be generated and kept for at least one year.

controls.title: Backup and Disaster Recovery
controls.mandate: Backup copies of data, software, and system images shall be taken and tested regularly.
